assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.placeholder: Ask about a price, stock, expiry or sales...
assistant.hint: Ask the price or stock of a product by name or barcode, what expires soon, what is low on stock (optionally for one supplier), today's sales, to write off stock, or to change prices.

lookup.rowNoStock: {{name}}: {{price}}, no stock record, location not recorded

price.expired: This preview timed out after 2 minutes. No price was changed. Ask again.
price.pinDescription_one: Approve the price change for 1 product
price.pinDescription_other: Approve the price change for {{count}} products

errors.INVALID_PROPOSAL: I could not understand that. Please rephrase.
errors.MODEL_REFUSED_UNSUPPORTED: I can look up product prices, stock, expiry dates, low stock and sales, write off stock and change prices for now.
errors.MODEL_REFUSED_UNSAFE: I cannot help with that request.
errors.MODEL_REFUSED_AMBIGUOUS: That is not clear enough. Which product do you mean?
errors.INPUT_TOO_LONG: That message is too long. Keep it short.
errors.PAYMENT_DATA: Please do not type card numbers here. The number was not sent anywhere.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many questions. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.AUTH_FORBIDDEN: Your role is not allowed to do that.
errors.DATA_UNAVAILABLE: The data is not available right now. Try again.
errors.AMBIGUOUS_TARGET: More than one thing matches. Pick one of the options.
errors.MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: The assistant is not available right now.
errors.MODEL_TIMEOUT: The assistant took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.TOO_MANY_ITEMS: That is too many products at once. Use 25 or fewer.
errors.STALE_TARGET: The stock or price changed since you asked. Ask again.
errors.NOT_OWNER: That request belongs to someone else.
errors.ALREADY_USED: That request was already used or closed.
errors.PROPOSAL_EXPIRED: The preview timed out. Nothing was changed. Ask again.
errors.TERMINAL_MISMATCH: That request was made on another till.
errors.PAYLOAD_MISMATCH: The request no longer matches what was shown. Nothing was changed. Ask again.
errors.ASSISTANT_LOCKED: The assistant is paused for you for a few minutes after too many refused requests.
errors.INVALID_APPROVAL: That PIN approval is not valid for this change. Nothing was changed.
errors.APPROVAL_REQUIRED: A manager PIN is needed to approve this change.
errors.AMBIGUOUS_APPROVAL: More than one manager matches that PIN. Nothing was changed.
errors.APPROVER_NOT_MANAGER: Only a manager or admin can approve this change. Nothing was changed.
errors.STOCK_CHANGED: Stock changed while you were approving. No stock was changed. Ask again.
errors.EXECUTION_FAILED: The change could not be applied. No stock was changed.
errors.RESULT_UNCONFIRMED: The result could not be confirmed, so the change may have been applied. Check the stock movements or the product prices before asking again.
